<thought>We need to create an ML-ready dataset from the consolidated polymorphs JSON using advanced feature engineering, a 0.2 test split, and normalization. We'll use the `prepare_tabular_dataset` tool, specifying the full input JSON path and an output directory within the current workspace. After the tool runs, we'll list the output directory to locate the metadata JSON file and then return its path.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_6/polymorph_data/consolidated_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_8/sulphide_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
